A '''reanimated aviansie''' can be spawned by casting the [[Arceuus spellbook|spell]] [[Master Reanimation]] on an [[ensouled aviansie head]]. The spell can be cast within a 31x31 area where the head was dropped by a monster. This will work indefinitely, even if the ensouled head is picked up, so long as it is not put into the [[bank]], [[trade]] screen, [[Grand Exchange]], or [[price checker]]. If the player has done one of these things, they will no longer be able to reanimate the aviansie in the area where it was killed, but can still reanimate it within range of the [[Dark Altar]].

Killing the creature will grant the player 1,234 [[Prayer]] [[experience]]. Just like its living form, this creature is immune to melee attacks, although they only attack with melee rather than ranged.
